more_info.overview: Glyceryl triacetate or triacetin is used as a humectant in food. Its technological role is to help retain moisture.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include chewing gum. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.daily_intake: For triacetin: No ADI specified (JECFA, 2002). This evaluation does not establish an ADI for every form in the named group.
